name: Détourage de personne (RVM)
description: Cuts the person out of the selected clip with Robust Video Matting (optional model rvm-mobilenetv3, 15 MB, GPL-3.0: PERSONAL USE ONLY, see the licence dialog). Creates a new video file: a black and white matte (white = the person), or the person over a flat colour (green by default). The matte is stable from one frame to the next (the network keeps a state). Variables: --var background=00B140.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Matte noir et blanc
entries.description: White person on black, usable as a luma matte.

entries.label: Personne sur fond uni
entries.description: The person over a flat colour (--var background=00B140 for green).
